test_title: PYST 41: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Contradict
solution: The correct answer is: **Contravene**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Contradict **means to deny or oppose a statement or belief. (किसी कथन या विश्वास का खंडन या विरोध करना) • **Example**: *She tried to contradict his argument, but he had strong evidence to support it.* • Marked option **Contravene **means to go against or violate a rule or law, which is similar in meaning to contradict. (किसी नियम या कानून के विरुद्ध जाना या उसका उल्लंघन करना) • The word can be used in sentences like "*Her actions contravene the company's policies*" or "*The new law contravenes the constitution*". Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Permit **means to allow or give permission for something. (किसी चीज़ की अनुमति देना) • **Verify **means to confirm or prove the truth of something. (किसी बात की सत्यता की पुष्टि या प्रमाण करना) • **Vouch **means to guarantee or support the truth of something. (किसी बात की सत्यता की गारंटी या समर्थन करना) 3e:T8d6, The correct answer is: "**Graviety**".
